name: toolkit
description: Tool-specific CLI guidance for operating local developer tools and bundled extensions with explicit compatibility and safety boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Operate local developer CLIs with bounded tool-specific guidance.
interface.longDescription: Provides bounded skills for inspecting, operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting local developer CLIs without treating incidental command usage as a plugin concern.
defaultPrompt: Use $toolkit:apple-container for Apple container CLI tasks on Apple silicon macOS, including common commands, lifecycle checks, compatibility limits, installation, uninstallation, containerization concepts, and the bundled experimental k8s plugin without assuming third-party Kubernetes CLI execution.
